runs.text: The Blind Men by the Road
As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
runs.originalText: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.

runs.text: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
